ImageDescription.value: Savina Monastery is located next to Herceg Novi, and was built in lush Mediterranean vegetation on one of the most beautiful parts of the northern Montenegrin coast. The monastery consists of three churches: the Small Church of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin, the Great Church of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin and the Temple of Saint Sava, after which the monastery was named.
